name: Holy Of Holies
overview: The Holy of Holies, described in Exodus 25, is the innermost and most sacred part of the tabernacle, where God promised to meet and commune with His people from above the mercy seat placed on the ark of the testimony. This space was adorned with two golden cherubim with outstretched wings covering the mercy seat, symbolizing God’s divine presence and holiness. A vail of finely woven linen with cherubim separated the Holy of Holies from the rest of the tabernacle, emphasizing its sanctity and restricted access.
